claim.quote: All eight crystals showed higher light yields than in COSINE-100, with values ranging from 15.8 to 27.7~p.e./keV; six crystals exceeded 20~p.e./keV.

name: Development and Initial Performance of an Upgraded NaI(Tl) Crystal Encapsulation for COSINE-100U

summary.plain: In the first performance paper of the upgraded detector, all eight crystals gave more light than in COSINE-100 (15.8 to 27.7 photoelectrons per keV) and the surface-alpha backgrounds fell.
summary.technical: Initial performance with 2462 h (102.6 d) of room-temperature COSINE-100U data at Yemilab, compared with 698 h (29.1 d) of late COSINE-100 data; direct PMT coupling via 2-mm silicone pads, beveled crystal edges, lower bulk-alpha and much lower 1-2 MeV surface-alpha rates (arXiv preprint).

title: Development and Initial Performance of an Upgraded NaI(Tl) Crystal Encapsulation for COSINE-100U
why_it_matters: Shows the upgrade delivered the higher light yield and lower backgrounds it was built for.
